ideas.title: Investigating ICE's use of force
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of force by ICE officers, including the incident involving Renee Good
questions: What are the protocols for ICE officers using force?
How often do ICE officers use force?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues within ICE and highlight the need for increased accountability and transparency. By investigating the use of force by ICE officers, we can better understand the circumstances surrounding Good's death and push for reforms to prevent similar incidents in the future.
